creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 2, part 1 of 3: the request envelope for acting. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md section 5.

What: every request carries a correlation id its answer and events repeat; answers are done, already so, refused (not found or a stated reason), not sent (never left this daemon; safe to retry) or unknown (sent, reply lost; may have happened). The daemon already tells the last two apart (Unsent and Unanswered in crates/muster-daemon/src/messages/peer.rs). Operation ids: a post and a new pane carry an id the client chooses; the daemon that carries out the request remembers ids for a retention period, across a reconnect and a handoff, and answers a repeat with already so and the original result. Settle the retention period (an open question in the MIP); record the answer on this card and in docs/architecture.md, since the accepted MIP is frozen.

Proves: a gate test client that retries an unknown request with the same operation id never acts twice, including across a daemon handoff; a refused request is never reported as unknown or the reverse.
title: MIP-10 stage 2a: correlation ids, not sent and unknown, operation ids
